plugin.name: Lumina
鼠标移至动态卡片时边框变为主题色: The card border turns into the theme color on hover
压缩卡片间距与内边距，一屏显示更多动态（仅主视图）: Tighter card spacing and padding so more notes fit on one screen (main view only)
仅压缩侧边栏卡片间距与内边距，不影响主视图: Compresses only the sidebar cards, leaving the main view unchanged
开启后，底栏卡片布局的底部信息栏将在昵称后追加「 | 个性签名」；关闭则仅显示昵: When on, the footer of footer-style cards appends “ | signature” after the nickname; when off, only the nickname is shown
开启后，无标题的笔记日期改为完整格式（如「年月日 星期 时:分」）；关闭则保持简: When on, untitled notes show a full date such as “Y/M/D Weekday H:M”; when off, a short date is used. Titled notes are unaffected
清风动态的排布方式：时序布局（按照日期分组单列）、卡片布局（三栏瀑布流）或底栏卡: How notes are arranged: timeline (one column, grouped by date), cards (three-column masonry) or cards with a footer
选择清风日历的展示形式: Choose how the Notes calendar is displayed
仅一张图片时的显示尺寸，默认即当前大小: Display width for a single image; the default is the current size
两张图片（两列）时的整体宽度，默认即当前大小: Overall width for two images (two columns); the default is the current size
四张图片（2×2）时的整体宽度，默认即当前大小: Overall width for four images (2×2); the default is the current size
三张 / 六张 / 九宫格（三列）时的整体宽度，默认即当前大小: Overall width for three, six or nine images (three columns); the default is the current size
超过设定行数的笔记会自动折叠，底部显示展开按钮。图片始终完整显示，只折叠文字部分: Notes longer than the given number of lines are collapsed and show an expand button. Images are always shown in full; only text is collapsed.
字号默认为 16，影响清风动态内容显示: Default 16; affects the text of Notes cards
正文行高，默认 2.0。数值越大行距越宽: Line height of body text, default 2.0. Larger values give more spacing
字间距，默认 0。单位 px，数值越大字越分散: Letter spacing in px, default 0. Larger values spread the text out
开启后，「全部笔记」右侧出现箭头，点击展开快速筛选（无标签/有评论/有图片/无图: When on, an arrow appears next to “All notes”; click it for quick filters (no tag / with comments / with images / no images / with links / with tasks / archived). Off by default.
开启后页面滚动更加丝滑，滚轮停止后内容还会惯性滑行一小段。: When on, scrolling feels smoother and glides a little after the wheel stops.
开启后，清风全部笔记视图将按设定条数分页，底部显示页码导航。默认关闭。: When on, the All notes view is paginated and shows page navigation at the bottom. Off by default.
分页开启时生效，决定每页显示的笔记数量。: Takes effect when pagination is on; sets how many notes are shown per page.
开启后，发布清风笔记时会自动同步写入思源笔记文档（使用「数据同步」设置中的模板与: When on, publishing a note also writes it into a SiYuan document using the template and target from Data sync. Off by default.
开启后在思源右侧边栏显示精简版清风面板。需要刷新思源笔记或重新打开思源笔记后才能: Shows a compact Notes panel in the right sidebar of SiYuan. Reload or restart SiYuan for it to take effect.
开启后，主输入框按 Enter 直接发布；Shift+Enter 仍然换行。关闭: When on, Enter publishes from the main input box and Shift+Enter inserts a line break. When off, use the send button.
开启后，左侧面板作为一个整体上下滚动，而非仅标签区独立滚动。: When on, the whole left panel scrolls together instead of only the tag list.
自定义清风左侧边栏的显示宽度，默认 260px（即当前大小）。: Width of the Notes left sidebar; default 260px (the current size).
显示在「每日回顾」顶部中央的个性签名。留空时回退使用「朋友圈设置 → 个性签名」: Signature shown at the top of Daily review. If empty, the signature from Moments settings is used.
显示在「本周记录」顶部中央的个性签名。留空时回退使用「朋友圈设置 → 个性签名」: Signature shown at the top of Weekly recap. If empty, the signature from Moments settings is used.
显示/隐藏工具栏标签按钮: Show or hide the tag button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏上传资源按钮: Show or hide the upload button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏任务列表按钮: Show or hide the task list button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏无序列表按钮: Show or hide the bullet list button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏有序列表按钮: Show or hide the numbered list button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏收起侧边栏按钮: Show or hide the collapse-sidebar button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏设置标题按钮: Show or hide the set-title button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏字体颜色按钮: Show or hide the text color button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏粗体按钮: Show or hide the bold button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏删除线按钮: Show or hide the strikethrough button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏高亮按钮: Show or hide the highlight button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏行级代码按钮: Show or hide the inline code button in the toolbar
显示/隐藏工具栏 Flomo 同步按钮（仅登录 Flomo 后可见）: Show or hide the Flomo sync button in the toolbar (visible only after signing in to Flomo)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏标签按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the tag button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏上传资源按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the upload button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏任务列表按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the task list button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏无序列表按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the bullet list button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏有序列表按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the numbered list button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏设置标题按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the set-title button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏字体颜色按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the text color button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏粗体按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the bold button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏删除线按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the strikethrough button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏高亮按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the highlight button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏行级代码按钮（独立于主视图，互不影响）: Show or hide the inline code button in the sidebar toolbar (independent of the main view)
显示/隐藏侧边栏工具栏 Flomo 同步按钮（仅登录 Flomo 后可见，独立于: Show or hide the Flomo sync button in the sidebar toolbar (visible only after signing in to Flomo; independent of the main view)
进入每日回顾后，每次随机/加权展示的笔记条数。可在清风左侧「每日回顾」里使用。: How many notes each random or weighted review shows. Available from Daily review in the Notes sidebar.
每日回顾只从选定时间范围内的笔记中抽取。默认「全部时间」。: Daily review only picks notes from the selected range. Default is All time.
开启后，越久没翻过的笔记越优先展示；每次回顾会记录已展示的笔记，下次降低其权重。: When on, notes you have not revisited for longer appear first; each review records what was shown and lowers its weight next time. When off, the pick is purely random.
明月视图中瀑布流的列数，默认 3 列: Number of masonry columns in Gallery, default 3
明月视图顶部显示的标题，留空则使用默认「明月」: Title shown at the top of Gallery; leave empty to use “Gallery”
开启后明月瀑布流的日期浮层显示到分钟（如「2026-09-12 20:59」）；: When on, the date overlay in Gallery shows minutes (e.g. 2026-09-12 20:59); when off, only the date is shown. On by default and independent of Show time in Moments.
同时显示在侧边栏和朋友圈封面: Shown both in the sidebar and on the Moments cover
发布朋友圈时使用的昵称，显示在头像卡片中: Nickname used when publishing Moments, shown on the avatar card
朋友圈动态卡片是否显示边框。默认开启（显示卡片边框），关闭后卡片不再显示边框。: Whether Moments cards show a border. On by default; when off, cards have no border.
开启后，根据动态的天气显示不同的卡片背景色（晴 / 多云 / 阴 / 雨 / 雪: When on, card backgrounds follow the weather of each moment (sunny / cloudy / overcast / rain / snow), so they are easy to tell apart. Off by default.
字号默认为 16，影响朋友圈动态内容显示: Default 16; affects the text of Moments cards
仅移动端生效，不影响 PC 端。字号默认为 15，不同手机屏幕观感不一，可在此单: Mobile only. Default 15; tune it for your phone screen without affecting desktop.
选择朋友圈日历的展示形式: Choose how the Moments calendar is displayed
开启后评论的日期/时间才显示：PC 端为鼠标悬停该条评论时显示，移动端为点击昵称: When on, comment dates appear: hover a comment on desktop, or tap the nickname menu on mobile. When off (default) comment dates are never shown. Applies to both desktop and mobile.
开启后朋友圈动态的时间显示到分钟（如「2026年9月12日 20:59」）；关闭: When on, moment times show minutes (e.g. 2026-09-12 20:59); when off, only the date is shown. On by default and applies to both desktop and mobile.
开启后，发布朋友圈动态时会自动同步写入思源笔记文档（使用「数据同步」设置中的模板: When on, publishing a moment also writes it into a SiYuan document using the template and target from Data sync. Off by default.
开启后，朋友圈中添加的图片/视频/文件不会出现在明月（拾光）视图中。默认开启。: When on, images, videos and files added to Moments do not appear in Gallery. On by default.
超过设定行数的朋友圈动态会自动折叠，底部显示展开按钮。图片始终完整显示，只折叠文: Moments longer than the given number of lines are collapsed and show an expand button. Images are always shown in full; only text is collapsed.
开启后进入朋友圈需要输入密码才能查看: When on, a passcode is required to open Moments
设置解锁密码，留空则等同于关闭锁屏。忘记密码可直接在设置中修改或清空: Set the unlock passcode; leaving it empty is the same as turning the lock screen off. If you forget it, change or clear it here.
锁屏界面的背景图路径或 URL，留空使用默认毛玻璃效果: Path or URL of the lock screen background; leave empty for the default frosted glass effect
同步目标为「每日日记」时的目标笔记本。点击下拉从工作区选择，留空则该功能不可用。: Notebook used when the sync target is Daily note. Pick one from the workspace; leave empty to disable the feature.
选择「插入今日日记」写入哪里。每日日记：写入所选笔记本的当日日记；指定文档：写入: Where Insert today's note writes to. Daily note: the day's note in the selected notebook. Specific document: a fixed document of your choice, grouped by date.
仅同步目标为「指定文档」时生效。点击「选择文档」从工作区树中选取，或手动粘贴文档: Only applies when the sync target is Specific document. Click Choose document to pick one from the workspace tree, or paste a block ID. Content is inserted with a heading per date group.
仅同步目标为「指定文档」时生效。倒序：新的日期分组排在前面，打开文档先看到最近的: Only applies when the sync target is Specific document. Newest first: recent date groups are at the top; Oldest first: older ones are at the top. Default is newest first.
开启后，手动或自动同步日记后会跳转到对应文档。关闭则后台静默写入，不打断当前操作: When on, syncing jumps to the target document. When off, it writes silently in the background. On by default.
选择「插入今日日记」时用哪种方式构造内容。Callout 类型：使用思源原生 C: How content is built when inserting today's note. Callout: native SiYuan callout blocks (> [!type]). Custom template: the template below, with placeholder substitution.
仅在同步模式为「Callout 类型」时生效，决定 Callout 块的样式类型: Only applies when the sync mode is Callout; sets the callout style
仅在同步模式为「自定义模板」时生效。点击按钮打开编辑器，可点选「年/月/日/时/: Only applies when the sync mode is Custom template. Click the button to open the editor and combine year/month/day/hour/minute/second with separators. Shared by Notes and Moments. Placeholders: {{date}}, {{time}}, {{datetime}}, {{year}}, {{month}}, {{day}}, {{hour}}, {{minute}}, {{second}}, {{tags}}, {{content}}, {{resources}}, {{comments}}, {{mood}}, {{weather}}, {{category}}, {{location}} (the last four are only filled when syncing Moments; they are empty for Notes)
开启后，只写入还没同步过的记录（手动同步、自动同步过的也算已同步），重复执行不会: When on, only records not yet synced are written (manual and automatic syncs both count as synced), so repeats do not duplicate content. When off, everything is rewritten every time. On by default.
把全部清风笔记写入思源笔记文档。写入目标沿用上方「数据同步」的「日记笔记本 /: Writes all Notes into SiYuan documents. The target comes from Data sync (daily note notebook / specific document) and the format from Sync template. Batch sync does not jump to the document.
把全部朋友圈动态写入思源笔记文档。写入目标沿用上方「数据同步」的「日记笔记本 /: Writes all Moments into SiYuan documents. The target comes from Data sync (daily note notebook / specific document) and the format from Sync template. Batch sync does not jump to the document.
从轻语（siyuan-lumina）插件导入说说（清风笔记）和朋友圈动态。导入时: Imports notes and moments from the original Lumina (siyuan-lumina) plugin. Data is converted on the fly: images are split out of the markdown body and timestamps become time strings; Moments fields map one to one. Records with an existing ID are skipped, so current data is never overwritten.
LifeLog 悬浮按钮记录时写入的日记笔记本。点击下拉从工作区选择，留空则使用: Notebook used by the LifeLog floating button. Pick one from the workspace; leave empty to use SiYuan's default daily note notebook.
鼠标悬停时卡片边框变为主题色并添加阴影: The card border turns into the theme color on hover, with a shadow
压缩侧边栏与时间轴卡片间距和内边距，一屏显示更多记录: Tighter spacing and padding in the sidebar and timeline so more records fit on one screen
结束模式（默认）：节点时间为结束时间，时长从上一条结束算到当前结束。\n开始模式:
End mode (default): a node's time is its end time, and the duration runs from the previous end to this end.
Start mode: a node's time is its start time, and the duration runs from this start to the next start. Durations are split per day when they cross midnight.
控制全部类型标签云中类型名称的字体大小，默认 14px: Font size of tag names in the tag cloud, default 14px
控制时间轴卡片中内容文字的字体大小，默认 14.5px: Font size of timeline card text, default 14.5px
开启后在思源右侧边栏显示 LifeLog 面板。需要刷新思源笔记或重新打开思源笔: Shows the LifeLog panel in the right sidebar of SiYuan. Reload or restart SiYuan for it to take effect.
压缩 Dock 面板的间距与内边距，一屏显示更多记录。: Tighter spacing and padding in the dock panel so more records fit on one screen.
时间轴卡片在时间区间右侧显示「持续：X分 / X时Y分」。: Timeline cards show “Duration: X min / X h Y min” next to the time range.
自定义LifeLog左侧边栏的显示宽度，默认 260px（即当前大小）。: Width of the LifeLog left sidebar; default 260px (the current size).
在思源手机端一键打开轻语的图文引导。点击查看「思源手机端增强」自动化模拟点击的配: Opens an illustrated guide for using Lumina on the SiYuan mobile app, including how to set up automated taps with the Mobile enhancement automation (mind-map style guide).

移动端朋友圈：显示/隐藏动态卡片边框: Mobile Moments: show or hide card borders
自定义移动端底部标签栏图标的显示尺寸，默认 21px（即当前大小）。: Icon size in the mobile bottom tab bar; default 21px (the current size).
开启后，启动思源笔记自动打开轻语标签页: When on, open Lumina automatically when SiYuan starts
控制导出图片相对于原图的缩放比例。100% 为原图大小，比例越小图片越小。默认: Scale of exported images relative to the original. 100% means original size; lower values give smaller images. Default 100%.
选择要导出的数据时间范围，仅在点击下方导出按钮时生效: Time range to export; applies when you click an export button below
导出清风数据时按标签筛选：可导出「全部数据」「无标签」，或从下方列表选择「某一个: Filter Notes exports by tag: All data, No tag, or a single tag from the list below. Applies when you click Export Notes data.
将清风笔记导出为所选格式的文件（受「导出格式 / 时间范围 / 清风导出范围」影: Export Notes to the chosen format (affected by Export format, time range and Notes export range)
